blocks.text: RPC 的运行时无关核心。 定义一次调用从发出到返回的全部语义：路由、超时、取消、分组、幂等、并发准入、错误还原、生命周期，并提供两层 API：

items: Runtime Peer（`@migaia/rpc-core/remote`）：`request` / `notify` / `stream` / `group` / `outcome`，按方法路径调用，带类型推导。进程、线程、浏览器、桥接包都在这一层上构建。
Endpoint（包根）：`createEndpoint` + 中间件，`send` / `provide`，用于在任意载体（iframe、BroadcastChannel、MessagePort 等）上自行组装。

在测试里模拟两个对端（真实的 Peer 与调用路径，内存传输）：
在任意载体上组装 Endpoint（这里用内存载体演示，换成 iframe、MessagePort 等时只换 transport）：

`createCoroutinePlugin({ name, task })` 创建受监督的同进程 task；task 内通过 `createCoroutinePlugin({ name, connect })` 把子 Host 接入当前代次的连接。两端使用 `host.coroutine` 调用，并沿用出口的事件与管理 API。`connect` 是 task 收到的 opaque 值；task 与 connect 必须二选一。
Task resolve 表示正常退出，reject 表示崩溃。Stop 通过 task 的 `signal` 协作取消，task 在 `finally` 中释放子 Host 后才结束；阻塞事件循环的 task 无法强制终止。`replace(name, { task })` 更换下一代任务。完整例子见 USEGUIDE 的 Coroutine 节。
`@migaia/rpc-core/probe` 在 Core Peer 或 Endpoint 上安装同步观察。默认只读元数据；请求、返回值与错误保持原有语义。下面的 `connect` 示例使用实际 MessagePort。managed Thread spawn 与 Process `spawn: true` 同样把原 `probe` 引用传入对应的 Peer。
Endpoint 用户把 `probePlugin` 放进既有 `middlewares`；它不会创建 transport：

`defineProbe(definition, host)` 直接为 `host` 添加五个 Probe 字段、注册私有状态并冻结该对象，返回 `THost & IRpcProbe`，与 `host` 为同一引用；原有成员保持不变，包括已有的 `emit`。私有状态持有 `definition.emit`，不会用它覆盖 host 的方法。省略 `host` 时沿用独立 handle 形式。`host` 必须是可扩展且未冻结的非 null 对象，不能已有这五个 Probe 字段或已注册为 Probe；验证失败时对象保持原样。

事件 view 仅在 `emit` 调用期间有效。需保留它时显式调用 `snapshotProbeEvent(view)`（SC9c）；快照复制顶层字段，`detail`、`error` 与 `content` 仍保留引用，调用方稍后修改对象时这些引用可见修改。录制 codec 在格式转换边界形成新表示（SC9b）。`methods` 只过滤 `message` 与 `envelope`；其它阶段只按采样过滤。采样使用 `(senderId, messageId)` 的稳定 FNV-1a 32 位键。

`capture` 默认关闭，必须显式列出需要捕获内容的阶段，且定义时为 `stages` 的子集。`protected` 内容也须显式启用，并只在认证保护路径存在时产生。`setStages([])` 暂停；恢复时设置所需阶段，原 `captureMask` 保持不变。host 的公开 `stageMask` 为初始定义值，后续选择保存在私有状态；独立 handle 的 getter 则反映当前值。详细契约见 USEGUIDE 的 Probe 节。
`sizeBytes` 只表示当前层已知的字节表示。字节 buffer/view 提供已有的精确字节长度；所有 string 的观察长度为 `-1`，不为观察额外编码或扫描内容。
已有消息端口或有序字节流时，用 `defineMessageAdapter` / `defineByteAdapter` 的 `open` 取得真实资源，再调用定义返回的 `peer` 或 `plugin`。通信、握手、治理和关闭沿用原 Core owner。完整可运行的 MessagePort、Host 与字节流例子见 USEGUIDE 第 9 节。
`./adapter/internal-advanced` 是仓库内原生 Process、Threads 与 Bridge 的低级接入入口；网站用户 API 索引以这两个任务级定义函数为适配器作者的起点。安装包仍保留原生包需要的实际导出。
Runtime Peer 支持 `await using`，其 `Symbol.asyncDispose` 就是原来的 `close` 函数，保留相同 Promise 与错误。Core 的 `createRuntimePeer` 可以省略 `self` 与 `report`：生成本地身份，后台错误默认交给 `console.error`。

独立 Peer 的 `on(event, listener)` 使用与 Host 出口相同的事件投影；返回的取消函数可重复调用。首次 ready 由 factory 的 `await` 表示，订阅不重放它。受监督的 Peer 只发布真实重启后的 ready 和原 supervisor 的 exit/restart/degraded；listener 只发布真实接受的 session ready。raw Peer 没有原生执行生命周期，不伪造 exit，也没有后续 ready。事件不能代替 `close` 或 `await using` 释放资源。完整可执行例子见 USEGUIDE 第 2.5 节。
这些规则对所有 RPC 包都成立：

items: 超时：`request` / `stream` 默认 30000 ms；单次调用用 `timeoutMs` 覆盖，`false` 关闭。
取消：`signal` 取消是协作式的，本地放弃等待，不保证对端没有开始执行。`cancel: 'before-start'` 只在对端尚未开始时撤销。
notify：只保证已发出，不代表对端执行成功。
group：一组 request 按顺序执行，失败后的步骤为 `not-executed`，不回滚。
幂等：带 `idempotencyKey` 的调用可用 `outcome(key)` 查询结果，`pending` / `done` / `unknown`。
并发准入：每个对端最多 64 个、全局最多 256 个同时执行的入站调用；超出返回 `OVERLOADED`，对端函数不被调用。
错误还原：对端抛出的错误还原为原生类型，保留 `message`、`stack` 与 `cause` 链。
重试：超时、取消、断线、`unknown` 都不能证明对端没执行。重试非幂等操作前先对账。

blocks.text: 按 `(source, code)` 分支，不要匹配 `message`。跨 Worker、iframe 或模块副本时，用 `isRpcErrorInstance`、`isRpcRemoteError`、`isRpcTimeoutError` 判断错误族，而不是 `instanceof`。全部错误码及处理建议见 USEGUIDE 第 10 节。

Memory transport delivery and deferred remote/governor control work use the existing scheduler contract. Default scheduling retains native microtasks. `createMemoryTransportPair({ scheduler })` controls only pair delivery; endpoint deadline clocks remain a separate constructor choice. Injected manual clocks must advance zero-time work for deferred reconciliation, departure notifications and policy close. Ordinary deadline `schedule(0)` behavior is unchanged.

sections.heading: 2.5 作用域释放与真实生命周期事件

blocks.text: 首次 ready 已经包含在 `await createThreadPeer(...)` / `await createRuntimePeer(...)` 的完成里。`on('ready')` 从订阅时开始，只观察原 registration 后来真正接受的新代次。受监督的 Peer 从原 supervisor 获取 exit/restart/degraded；listener 的 ready 来自实际接受的 session。raw Peer 没有原生执行生命周期，不伪造 exit 或后续 ready。事件不是资源 disposer；释放仍用 `close` 或 `await using`。
下面的 Node Worker 自然退出，由真实 supervisor 发布 exit；父线程等待该事实，然后由 `await using` 释放 Peer：
`Symbol.asyncDispose` 与 `close` 是同一函数引用，重复或并发调用保留同一个原 Promise。取消订阅不会停止 Worker；Peer 开始关闭时注销其事件订阅。listener 没有原生执行控制，raw Peer 也不会把逻辑关闭包装成原生 exit。

`createRuntimePlugin`、本包的 `createCoroutinePlugin`，以及平台包的 `createProcessPlugin`、`createThreadPlugin` 返回可以用 `@migaia/plugin-host` 安装的插件。同一运行时家族的连接共享一个出口：`host.process`、`host.thread` 或 `host.coroutine`（名称见 `RuntimePluginKey`）。

订阅事件，返回可重复调用的取消函数。事件名见 `RuntimeEventName`：`ready`、`exit`、`degraded`、`restart`、`terminal`、`liquidated`

blocks.text: A local Feature method in `expose` is callable from the moment the peer can reach it; calls that arrive during install are held until the plugin commits, and are refused with `TARGET_UNKNOWN` if it does not. This guarantee covers local Feature `expose` entries only; forward and catalog entries are not covered.

`createCoroutinePlugin({ name, task, supervisor? })` 是父模式：创建受监督的 task，每个代次拥有自己的 `MessageChannel`。Task 收到 `signal`、`heartbeat()` 与 opaque `connect`；子模式 `createCoroutinePlugin({ name, connect })` 只接入该连接，不创建执行单元。两模式都支持 `provide` 与 `expose`；使用 `expose` 时先安装本端 provider 插件，再安装 runtime 插件。

`task` 与 `connect` 必须二选一；`connect` 只能使用当前 task 收到的值，不能传 `MessagePort`。父模式可通过 `supervisor` 配置现有监督策略，默认预算为每个插件一个 coroutine 单元。`host.coroutine.replace('math', { task: nextTask })` 更换任务；非函数 task 在替换前以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝，旧单元继续提供服务。

Task resolve 产生正常退出，reason 为 `exited`；reject 产生崩溃，reason 为 `crashed`，后续处理遵循监督策略。终止重启链的错误通过 `terminal` 事件提供 `{ source, code }`，`name` 是插件连接名。Stop 的 signal 取消是协作式的，端口在 task 结束后关闭；忽略取消的 task 可延迟结束，预算租约保留到实际 settlement。Coroutine 共享父事件循环，无法强制停止阻塞事件循环的 task。
Endpoint 是更底层的 API：没有握手时的方法目录交换，调用按"目标 id + 方法名"路由。

sections.heading: 7. 按需组装：减小打包体积

blocks.text: `createEndpoint` 包含全部能力。只需要部分能力时：

rows: 提供方法并保留出站调用
从 `./features/*` 中显式挑选功能模块

blocks.text: `./features/*` 提供 `createOutboundFeature`、`createProviderFeature`、`createOneWayFeature`、`createDiscoveryFeature`、`createControlFeature`，`./stream` 提供流式与分片重组功能。`createProviderAdmissionScope` 用于让多个 Endpoint 共享同一组并发额度。

入站并发：每个对端最多 64 个、全局最多 256 个同时执行的调用（request / notify / stream 都计入）。超出时调用方收到 `OVERLOADED`，对端函数不会被调用。可通过 `providerLimits` 调整，并用 `onRejected` 观察拒绝原因。调用方的 `OVERLOADED` 错误不包含具体原因；要区分是并发满还是其它准入原因，看对端的 `onRejected`。
重放窗口：为了识别重复投递的消息，Core 会在一段时间内记住已完成的调用。

items: 进程与线程的原生独占通道（由平台包的 launcher 建立）只记录在途调用，不受下面的速率限制。

其它载体（浏览器载体、BroadcastChannel、自定义载体）使用有界账本：出站每个 Endpoint 4096 条，入站每个对端 1024 条、全局 4096 条，每条保留 310000 ms。由此得到的持续速率上限约为：出站每个 Endpoint 13.2 次/秒，入站每个对端 3.3 次/秒、全局 13.2 次/秒。这是持续速率的上限，不是吞吐量：短时突发可以超过它，但总量受账本容量约束。高频场景请合并调用（批量参数或 `group`）。

blocks.text: 幂等存储：`createRpcIdempotencyStore({ retentionMs, maxEntries, maxEntriesPerScope, maxBytes, maxOutcomeBytes })` 创建有界的幂等结果存储，用于 `idempotencyKey` 去重与 `outcome` 查询。默认的内存存储在进程重启后会丢失，`outcome` 此时会报告连续性已中断。

sections.heading: 9. 高阶用法：编写一个适配器

blocks.text: `@migaia/rpc-core/adapter` 提供 `defineMessageAdapter({ open, launch? })` 和 `defineByteAdapter({ open, listen?, dial? })`。定义完成后，用 `adapter.peer(options)` 创建独立 Peer，用 `adapter.plugin(options)` 安装到 Host。`open` 返回真实消息端口或有序字节 I/O；Core 继续完成原来的握手、能力协商、方法目录与收发。

rows: `open` 打开端口；可选 `launch` 调用运行时原有启动操作
`open` 打开字节流；可选 `dial` 拨号、`listen` 取得一条已接受的字节流

blocks.text: 下面是完整的第三方 MessagePort 适配器。它只用公开 SDK；两个原生端口由示例创建和关闭。
同一个定义也能构造真正的 Host Plugin。Host 的原安装批次管理连接与资源，插件只公开 `expose` 中的 Host 方法。
`defineByteAdapter` 同样只接物理 I/O。下面用 Node 标准库的两条 PassThrough 演示有序双向字节流；握手、分帧和目录交换仍由 Core 完成。

`launch` 真的调用定义中提供的物理启动操作，并返回端口、`exited` 与 `terminate`。现有运行时可以把自己的 supervisor 的原启动结果交给它；重启、预算与原生退出观察继续属于那个 supervisor。Core 的消息 resource 在握手失败、冷启动取消及 Peer 关闭时，通过同一个 termination-once owner 释放这个实际句柄。rpc-process 与 rpc-threads 的完整 managed 来源仍交给原 supervision 与 generation owner。

治理配置保留为 `peer` / `plugin` 的 `governor` 和 `scope` 选项。`governor` 使用原 rate、payload、连续超时与 idle 策略；其 disposer 挂在实际连接的 close owner 上。`adapter.scope(store?)` 创建原 provider scope，调用方共享它时，在所有 Peer 关闭后执行 `scope.close()`。作用域使用 Core 从实际连接捕获的认证 principal；普通借用端口的地址字符串不提供 principal。需要会话幂等作用域时，字节 responder 必须使用实际 `auth.verify`。
`./adapter/internal-advanced` 保留原生 Process、Threads 与 JSON-RPC Bridge 仍需要的低级操作。第三方的起点是上面的两个定义函数；它们不接受成品 Peer、channel、已协商能力、可信身份或 ownership 声明。
字节握手的 `auth.verify` 原始失败通过本地 `cause` 和可信 `report` 保留；发给对端的拒绝只含净化摘要，不序列化 verifier 的原始错误链。
适配器自己的错误继续用 `@migaia/utils/error` 的 `attachErrorIdentity` 附加自己的 source/code，并保留原错误在 `cause` 上；协议错误继续由原 Core/Contract owner 产生。
所有错误都是原生 `Error`（或子类），附带 `source` 与 `code`。按 `(source, code)` 分支，不要匹配 `message`。

items: `isRpcErrorInstance`、`isRpcRemoteError`、`isRpcTimeoutError` 按稳定字段判断，跨 Worker、iframe、模块副本都有效；不要依赖 `instanceof`。
`isRpcError` 只检查 `code` 是否为字符串，不能代替上面三个守卫。
错误类（`RpcError`、`RpcRemoteError`、`RpcTimeoutError` 等）只作为类型导出。唯一可构造的运行时类是 `RpcLifecycleError`，供持有自身释放状态的消费方（例如 Store Worker）报告生命周期失败。

blocks.text: 转发
插件可以用 `expose` 公开它已接受连接的方法前缀，让第三方经它转发调用。每一跳固定当时的目标代次，最多三跳，成环或超过时拒绝。最终提供方认证的是直接上一跳，而不是最初的调用者。中继不缓存业务结果。
重试原则
先看 `(source, code)` 与调用进行到了哪一步。只有能独立确认对端没有执行时（例如 `OVERLOADED`、`before-start` 撤销成功），才可以直接重试。超时、断线、`unknown`、连接恢复都不能证明未执行：给调用加 `idempotencyKey`，失败后用 `outcome(key)` 查询，或按业务规则对账。退避与总时间预算由调用方控制。
`notify` 成功了，对端却没执行？ `notify` 只保证已发出。需要确认时用 `request`。
为什么我的调用同步抛错了？ 参数、方法名或选项在发出前就不合法。把调用放进 `try` 块。
浏览器载体上高频调用被拒绝？ 非独占载体的重放账本有持续速率上限（第 8 节）。合并调用，或改用原生独占通道。
能自己定义新的协议级能力吗？ 不能。自定义中间件可以做日志、诊断、策略；新的根能力需要在 Core 内实现。

`@migaia/rpc-core/probe` 是运行时无关的观察契约入口，导出阶段、方向、kind、outcome 的数值常量与同顺序名称表，以及 `defineProbe`、`snapshotProbeEvent`、`rpcProbeSampleKey`、`probePlugin`、`readProbeStages`、`subscribeProbeStages`，以及既有 `hostRethrowReporter` / `IpcReporterContext` reporter。

Core Peer 的 `probe` 与 Endpoint 的 `probePlugin` 安装同一 emitter。事件同步交给所订阅的 Probe；throw、reject、redact 或 describe 失败通过 `onError` 报告 `PROBE_FAILED`，原始错误留在 `cause`，不进入业务管道。没有 `onError` 时使用宿主 reporter。Process、Thread、Browser Peer、pool member 与 managed spawn 均转发原 Probe 引用；监督退出与重启由既有生命周期 owner 发出 peer 事件。

`probe` 可以是单个 handle 或 readonly 数组。`defineProbe` 在定义时验证选项并编译 `stageMask`、`captureMask`、`methods` 与 `sampleThreshold`；返回对象被冻结，私有状态保留原 `definition.emit` callback。定义失败抛出原生 `TypeError`，带 `@migaia/rpc/core` / `INVALID_CONFIG`。
调用方已有对象需要同时提供其它 API 时，使用 revision 2 的 `defineProbe(definition, host)`。它直接为 `host` 添加 Probe 字段，以该对象的身份注册私有状态，然后冻结 `host`；返回类型为 `THost & IRpcProbe`，不复制或合并到另一个对象。原有成员与引用保持不变，省略 `host` 的形式仍返回独立 handle。

`host` 必须为可扩展、未冻结的非 null 对象，不能已经拥有 `stageMask`、`captureMask`、`methods`、`sampleThreshold`、`setStages`，也不能已经注册为 Probe。所有验证在修改对象之前完成；失败以 `TypeError` / `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝，`host` 不变。已有 `host.emit` 允许保留，附加操作不会覆盖它；Probe 私有状态使用 `definition.emit`。后续 emitter 在安装时从私有 WeakMap 读取编译状态，放入自己的固定形状记录；热路径读取该记录，不读取带额外成员的 `host`。

blocks.text: `rpcProbeSampleKey(senderId, messageId)` 对二者拼接后的 UTF-8 字节计算 FNV-1a 32 位键。调用方与接收方使用相同标识，所以同一交互的两侧采样决定一致；它不是认证机制或唯一身份。

`IRpcProbeEventView.variation` 在 variation envelope 的 `message` 与 `envelope` 事件中保留原 `route.variation` 字符串引用，包括 `ping`、`pong`、`close`、`abort` 与已注册的用户 subtype。`abort` 的 kind 仍为 `cancel`，其余 variation 为 `control`；request、response 与其它阶段的 variation 为 `undefined`。`methods: ['echo']` 保留 echo 的方法事件及没有 method 的 variation，排除其它 method；variation 仍受已配置的采样规则约束。

sections.heading: 13.2 View 生命周期与内容捕获

blocks.text: 每个 emitter 复用固定形状的 `IRpcProbeEventView`。只能在同步 `emit` 中读取它；需要稍后读取时使用快照：

`snapshotProbeEvent` 是显式复制请求（SC9c）：复制并冻结顶层字段，保留 `detail`、`error` 与 `content` 的引用和所有权。它防止复用 view 改写快照的顶层元数据，不固定这些引用对象的内容。按照 SC9，普通捕获与存储保留引用；调用方发送后修改 `detail`、错误或未被转移的 content 对象，后续读取仍可见修改。只有实际 transfer 会分离的字节缓冲、真实 codec/序列化边界（SC9b），或显式快照 API 才复制必要数据。未知 `sizeBytes`、未分块的 chunk 字段、非批次的 `members` 与未结算的 `durationMs` 都使用 `-1`。
`protected` 仅在认证保护路径存在时产生；没有该能力的路径不会伪造该阶段。内容捕获包括 protected 内容都必须显式启用。Descriptor 的 `stageMask` 描述 endpoint 能产生且当前已订阅的阶段，不证明所有路径都会经历每个阶段。

`sizeBytes` 只读取已知的原生字节 backing/view 长度。所有字符串与 opaque container 均为 `-1`，包括 string transport；metadata 不扫描、编码或规范化 payload。Byte carrier 复用其现成 frame 长度。各载体与 Core 复用 `adapter/internal-advanced` 的 `carrierSizeBytes` owner。

`setStages([])` 允许暂停，之后可以设置其它已知阶段。它更新私有状态的阶段选择，保留定义时的 `captureMask`；host 上不可写的 `stageMask` 仍为初始定义值，独立 handle 的 `stageMask` getter 反映当前私有值。非法阶段会抛出 `INVALID_CONFIG` 并保留旧 mask。`readProbeStages(probe)` 读取当前有效 mask；`subscribeProbeStages(probe, listener)` 在每次实际变更后通知一次，返回可重复调用的释放函数。两者用于冷控制边界，不加入消息热路径。

Endpoint 用户在激活前安装 `probePlugin`。Peer 用户只需传入 `probe`。Core 在激活后交付一次 descriptor；只有载体实际提供 `observe` 才调用它，释放函数由现有 resource scope 在关闭时执行。Peer 阶段覆盖 handshake、ready、exit、restart、directory 与 closing。冷 `subscribeProbeStages` listener 抛错时，`setStages` 仍先通知其余 listener，使已安装 emitter 采用新 mask，再传播 `CALLBACK_FAILED`；单个可附码原生错误保留身份。
`setStages([])` 暂停后不再构造所选事件；关闭后不再发送事件。

`IRpcProbeEventView.carrierSeq` 是同一 emitter 的 inbound carrier 序号；没有链接时为 `-1`。Core 在同步 receive 入口取走它，并沿原 physical record 穿过异步 unprotect/decode。Collector 在读取时，按原 endpoint 字符串及 source 序号转换为自己的全局 wire 序号，无链接字段省略。尚未解析的 origin 若已从主环、record 与 watch 的所有保留窗口淘汰，首次读取不能恢复该链接；已读取解析的链接在其 dependent 行仍保留时继续有效。读取时观察到同一 endpoint 的 source 序号重置，会给旧 origin 保留 cutoff，阻止其关联 cutoff 后的新行，同时保留历史链接；collector 不在摄取时维护额外 generation 历史。
Outbound carrier 借用本次 send 的原 envelope，携带 messageId、senderId、targetId、trace；同步 send 返回后立即清空。仓库载体都在 send 内同步 emit；第三方载体若跨异步间隙再 emit，没有这份 context。Physical batch 使用其第一个实际成员作代表，不展开 payload 成员。

Byte 业务 receive 的 carrier 事件在实际交付 Core 前发出。启动时排队的帧在交付时各发一次，时间是交付时间；关闭或溢出前未交付的业务帧不发业务 carrier 事件。Byte detail 是复用引用：`frameBytes` 是当前帧跨度，`drainMs` 初始 `-1`，native writer 的真实 false/drain 随后更新最近借用 detail；观察本身不改变原 write settlement，也不追加异步 carrier 事件。
`probePlugin` 保留 fast/native/batch/chunk 选择。Fast-capable descriptor 仍包含可能产生的 frame 阶段，单次 fast send 不伪造 frame。认证 descriptor 从既有配置读取 sign 或 encrypt-sign。

采样在解密前没有 sender/message identity；不能保证与后续逻辑阶段采用相同 key。Native Peer 调用选项不携带 trace，应用在自己的 Endpoint.send 边界显式传递已有 trace。多块消息完成解码前的匿名 carrier/protected/frame 当前不能全部归入 hub interaction；完成解码的最后一块可通过 carrierSeq 关联，前序原始记录保留，不猜测身份。
捕获容器中的 nested transferable 保留原引用，不遍历 getter、不深扫描或复制；其成员可能在实际 transfer 后分离。只有直接捕获且确会分离的 backing/view 按 SC9(a) 保存字节。

guidance.heading: 13.2 View 生命周期与内容捕获

blocks.text: 每个 emitter 复用固定形状的 `IRpcProbeEventView`。只能在同步 `emit` 中读取它；需要稍后读取时使用快照：

`snapshotProbeEvent` 是显式复制请求（SC9c）：复制并冻结顶层字段，保留 `detail`、`error` 与 `content` 的引用和所有权。它防止复用 view 改写快照的顶层元数据，不固定这些引用对象的内容。按照 SC9，普通捕获与存储保留引用；调用方发送后修改 `detail`、错误或未被转移的 content 对象，后续读取仍可见修改。只有实际 transfer 会分离的字节缓冲、真实 codec/序列化边界（SC9b），或显式快照 API 才复制必要数据。未知 `sizeBytes`、未分块的 chunk 字段、非批次的 `members` 与未结算的 `durationMs` 都使用 `-1`。
`protected` 仅在认证保护路径存在时产生；没有该能力的路径不会伪造该阶段。内容捕获包括 protected 内容都必须显式启用。Descriptor 的 `stageMask` 描述 endpoint 能产生且当前已订阅的阶段，不证明所有路径都会经历每个阶段。

`sizeBytes` 只读取已知的原生字节 backing/view 长度。所有字符串与 opaque container 均为 `-1`，包括 string transport；metadata 不扫描、编码或规范化 payload。Byte carrier 复用其现成 frame 长度。各载体与 Core 复用 `adapter/internal-advanced` 的 `carrierSizeBytes` owner。

`setStages([])` 允许暂停，之后可以设置其它已知阶段。它更新私有状态的阶段选择，保留定义时的 `captureMask`；host 上不可写的 `stageMask` 仍为初始定义值，独立 handle 的 `stageMask` getter 反映当前私有值。非法阶段会抛出 `INVALID_CONFIG` 并保留旧 mask。`readProbeStages(probe)` 读取当前有效 mask；`subscribeProbeStages(probe, listener)` 在每次实际变更后通知一次，返回可重复调用的释放函数。两者用于冷控制边界，不加入消息热路径。

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content: Compose actual endpoint or runtime peers while keeping transport and lifecycle ownership with their canonical owners.

declaredConfiguration.name: protocol
declaredConfiguration.description: Semantic descriptor feeding the codec edge in the canonical endpoint pipeline.

declaredConfiguration.name: codec
declaredConfiguration.description: Codec whose output must match the selected framer input exactly.

declaredConfiguration.name: framer
declaredConfiguration.description: Framer whose output is the value delivered to the selected transport.

declaredConfiguration.name: features
declaredConfiguration.description: Finite immutable tuple of user-defined features installed by the canonical Host batch.

declaredConfiguration.name: transport
declaredConfiguration.type: Omit<IRpcTransport<unknown>, 'send'> & { readonly send: (value: IRpcEnvelope, options?: IRpcSendOptions) => void | Promise<void>; }

declaredConfiguration.name: id
declaredConfiguration.description: Stable local endpoint identity included in every routed protocol envelope.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Endpoint monotonic clock and timers; the same injected instance also drives PluginHost deadlines. `now()` must return finite non-negative milliseconds and is never read as an epoch.

declaredConfiguration.name: wallClock
declaredConfiguration.description: Endpoint wall clock; only produces wire `sentAt` and hook event `at` diagnostics. `timestamp()` must return non-negative safe-integer epoch milliseconds. Defaults to the host wall clock.

declaredConfiguration.name: targetIds
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional known-peer seed; automatic discovery may resolve additional target ids lazily.

declaredConfiguration.name: provider
declaredConfiguration.description: Initial provider methods registered before endpoint construction completes.

declaredConfiguration.name: providerLimits
declaredConfiguration.description: Provider concurrency budgets; defaults to 256 global and 64 per peer.

declaredConfiguration.name: idempotency
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional store and session scope used only for keyed provider requests.

declaredConfiguration.name: idempotency.scope
declaredConfiguration.type: (admission: Readonly<{ token: string; senderId: string; }>) => string

declaredConfiguration.name: replay
declaredConfiguration.type: { /** Maximum retained outbound request identifiers; defaults to 4096. */ readonly maxEntries?: number; /** Retention time for outbound request identifiers; defaults to 310 seconds. */ readonly ttlMs?: number; }
declaredConfiguration.description: Bounds outbound identifier replay reservations for this endpoint.

declaredConfiguration.name: replay.maxEntries
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum retained outbound request identifiers; defaults to 4096.

declaredConfiguration.name: replay.ttlMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Retention time for outbound request identifiers; defaults to 310 seconds.

declaredConfiguration.name: middlewares
declaredConfiguration.description: Ordered middleware tuple installed atomically during endpoint construction.

declaredConfiguration.name: construction
declaredConfiguration.type: { /** Aborts construction while still rolling back every installed middleware. */ readonly signal?: IAbortSignal; /** Bounds endpoint construction, or disables the deadline when explicitly `false`. */ readonly timeoutMs?: number | false; }
declaredConfiguration.description: Cancellation and deadline controls for middleware installation and rollback.

declaredConfiguration.name: construction.signal
declaredConfiguration.description: Aborts construction while still rolling back every installed middleware.

declaredConfiguration.name: construction.timeoutMs

symbols.signature: export type IRpcEndpoint<TTargetId extends string = string, TMode extends IRpcDiscoveryMode = 'automatic', TPing extends boolean = boolean> = { provide(method: string, provider: IRpcProvider): IRpcEndpoint<TTargetId, TMode, TPing>; on(event: string, listener: IRpcEventListener): () => void; send<T>(targetId: TTargetId, method: string, data: unknown, options?: ISendOptions): Promise<T>; sendAll<T>(method: string, data: unknown, options?: ISendOptions): Promise<IRpcFanoutResult<T>>; dispatch(targetId: TTargetId, method: string, data: unknown): void; dispatchAll(method: string, data: unknown): void; /** Submit one atomic request group to an actually admitted native peer. */ group(targetId: TTargetId, steps: IRpcRuntimeGroupSteps, options?: IRpcRuntimeGroupOptions): Promise<readonly IRpcRuntimeStepOutcome[]>; /** Read a logical key's original stored outcome without executing its providers again. */ outcome(targetId: TTargetId, idempotencyKey: string): Promise<IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult>; /** Announce a bounded drain window to one peer without closing the channel in core. */ announceClose(targetId: TTargetId, options: { readonly drainMs: number; readonly receiverId?: string; }): Promise<void>; readonly connect: IRpcConnectControlForMode<TTargetId, TMode>; readonly discovery: IRpcDiscoveryControl<TTargetId>; readonly hooks: { on(listener: IRpcHook): () => void; }; dispose(): Promise<void>; } & IRpcPingEndpointSurface<TPing>;
symbols.purpose: Application-owned complete endpoint surface; middleware selection narrows discovery and ping capabilities.
symbols.core:
provide: Registers one provider for a unique method name; duplicate registration throws PROVIDER_DUPLICATED.
provide.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
provide.provider: Application callback receives IRpcContext and returns context.success or context.failed synchronously or asynchronously. Legacy ordinary throws usually become INTERNAL; trusted wire summaries and SCHEMA_INVALID retain public classification. Runtime operations serialize the original failure.
The same endpoint for chaining; disposal rejects new registrations.
on: Registers a one-way event listener; callbacks receive IRpcContext and async failures are observed through endpoint hooks.
on.event: Application event name matching the sender dispatch method.
on.listener: Application callback receives IRpcContext, returns void or Promise<void>, and should not retain expired response operations.
Idempotent unsubscriber removes only this registration.
send: Sends a correlated scalar request to the selected receiver and waits for one actual provider result.
send.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
send.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
send.data: Application request payload validated by the installed contract/codec.
send.options: Optional ISendOptions supplied by the caller; timeout, cancellation, transfer, idempotency and trace remain explicit.
Promise of provider data; remote business failure, cancellation, deadline, transport or lifecycle failure rejects with its native coded error. A synchronous UUID admission failure releases operation signal listeners; ordinary send cancellation keeps RpcAbortError.
sendAll: Sends the same scalar method to the statically configured target seeds and keeps each target success/failure separately.
sendAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
sendAll.data: Application payload sent independently to every selected target.
sendAll.options: Caller ISendOptions applied to the selected fan-out operations.
IRpcFanoutResult maps receiver/target keys to fulfilled data or original rejected errors.
dispatch: Sends a legacy one-way event without awaiting business completion; pair with on on the receiving endpoint.
dispatch.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
dispatch.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatch.data: Application event payload for the receiving listener.
Returns void once dispatch is initiated; failures are contained in endpoint hooks.
dispatchAll: Dispatches one event to the statically configured target seeds without waiting for business listeners.
dispatchAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatchAll.data: Application event payload for each selected target.
Returns void after scheduling selected dispatches; hooks observe failures.
group: Reserves every request-only step before execution, then runs in order until first failure; successful earlier effects are not rolled back.
group.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
group.steps: Application nonempty method/payload array admitted as IRpcRuntimeGroupSteps.
group.options: Optional IRpcRuntimeGroupOptions with actual ordering/cancellation/idempotency and local send controls.
Promise of actual step outcomes; unsupported native group capability rejects before dispatch.
outcome: Reads an original logical key outcome from the provider store without executing providers again.
outcome.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
outcome.idempotencyKey: Original application-issued key used for the same earlier logical operation.
IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult reports pending/done/unknown and store continuity; unknown never proves nonexecution.
announceClose: Announces a bounded drain window to one peer while leaving actual physical close with its owning adapter.
announceClose.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
announceClose.options: Caller drainMs duration and optional receiverId from discovery; this is a relative peer announcement.
Resolves when the close control is sent; it does not await remote resource disposal.
ping: Checks one actual receiver liveness; requires installed ping capability and actual negotiated support.
ping.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
ping.receiverId: Specific receiver identifier returned by discovery candidates or connect.getServerList; never invent an instance address.
ping.options: Optional IRpcPingOptions with local signal and deadline override.
Promise<boolean> for the observed reply; disposal settles an active ping as false. Calling after disposal or without ping capability throws its coded error. Ping cancellation does not require abort middleware.
pingAll: Checks liveness of the statically configured target seeds and retains individual success/failure results.
IRpcFanoutResult<boolean> keyed by the selected actual receivers.
connect: Connection/discovery controls derived from the actual middleware tuple; manual mode exposes query and registration operations.
discovery: Read-only candidate listing and explicit receiver pin controls sharing the canonical discovery owner.
hooks: Local diagnostic subscription facade; hooks.on receives IRpcHookEvent and returns an unsubscriber.
dispose: Idempotently stops admission, drains owned work and releases middleware/adapter resources in the canonical lifecycle order.
Promise resolves after disposal; cleanup failures remain reachable through standard cause/errors traversal, including all failures in the same batch; future operations fail ENDPOINT_DISPOSED.

send: Sends a correlated scalar request to the selected receiver and waits for one actual provider result.
send.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
send.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
send.data: Application request payload validated by the installed contract/codec.
send.options: Optional ISendOptions supplied by the caller; timeout, cancellation, transfer, idempotency and trace remain explicit.
Promise of provider data; remote business failure, cancellation, deadline, transport or lifecycle failure rejects with its native coded error. A synchronous UUID admission failure releases operation signal listeners; ordinary send cancellation keeps RpcAbortError.
sendAll: Sends the same scalar method to the statically configured target seeds and keeps each target success/failure separately.
sendAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
sendAll.data: Application payload sent independently to every selected target.
sendAll.options: Caller ISendOptions applied to the selected fan-out operations.
IRpcFanoutResult maps receiver/target keys to fulfilled data or original rejected errors.
dispatch: Sends a legacy one-way event without awaiting business completion; pair with on on the receiving endpoint.
dispatch.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
dispatch.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatch.data: Application event payload for the receiving listener.
Returns void once dispatch is initiated; failures are contained in endpoint hooks.
dispatchAll: Dispatches one event to the statically configured target seeds without waiting for business listeners.
dispatchAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatchAll.data: Application event payload for each selected target.
Returns void after scheduling selected dispatches; hooks observe failures.
group: Reserves every request-only step before execution, then runs in order until first failure; successful earlier effects are not rolled back.
group.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
group.steps: Application nonempty method/payload array admitted as IRpcRuntimeGroupSteps.
group.options: Optional IRpcRuntimeGroupOptions with actual ordering/cancellation/idempotency and local send controls.
Promise of actual step outcomes; unsupported native group capability rejects before dispatch.
outcome: Reads an original logical key outcome from the provider store without executing providers again.
outcome.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
outcome.idempotencyKey: Original application-issued key used for the same earlier logical operation.
IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult reports pending/done/unknown and store continuity; unknown never proves nonexecution.
announceClose: Announces a bounded drain window to one peer while leaving actual physical close with its owning adapter.
announceClose.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
announceClose.options: Caller drainMs duration and optional receiverId from discovery; this is a relative peer announcement.
Resolves when the close control is sent; it does not await remote resource disposal.
ping: Checks one actual receiver liveness; requires installed ping capability and actual negotiated support.
ping.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
ping.receiverId: Specific receiver identifier returned by discovery candidates or connect.getServerList; never invent an instance address.
ping.options: Optional IRpcPingOptions with local signal and deadline override.
Promise<boolean> for the observed reply; disposal settles an active ping as false. Calling after disposal or without ping capability throws its coded error. Ping cancellation does not require abort middleware.
pingAll: Checks liveness of the statically configured target seeds and retains individual success/failure results.
IRpcFanoutResult<boolean> keyed by the selected actual receivers.
connect: Connection/discovery controls derived from the actual middleware tuple; manual mode exposes query and registration operations.
discovery: Read-only candidate listing and explicit receiver pin controls sharing the canonical discovery owner.
hooks: Local diagnostic subscription facade; hooks.on receives IRpcHookEvent and returns an unsubscriber.
dispose: Idempotently stops admission, drains owned work and releases middleware/adapter resources in the canonical lifecycle order.
Promise resolves after disposal; cleanup failures remain reachable through standard cause/errors traversal, including all failures in the same batch; future operations fail ENDPOINT_DISPOSED.

items: `isRpcErrorInstance`、`isRpcRemoteError`、`isRpcTimeoutError` 按稳定字段判断，跨 Worker、iframe、模块副本都有效；不要依赖 `instanceof`。

错误类（`RpcError`、`RpcRemoteError`、`RpcTimeoutError` 等）只作为类型导出。唯一可构造的运行时类是 `RpcLifecycleError`，供持有自身释放状态的消费方（例如 Store Worker）报告生命周期失败。

blocks.text: 公开错误形状使用 `IRpcError`；平台与拓扑值域使用 `IRpcPlatformValue`、`IRpcTransportTopologyValue`。工厂组合类型从实际调用结果推导，认证 nonce 由认证 owner 内部生成。

items: `isRpcErrorInstance`、`isRpcRemoteError`、`isRpcTimeoutError` 按稳定字段判断，跨 Worker、iframe、模块副本都有效；不要依赖 `instanceof`。
`isRpcError` 只检查 `code` 是否为字符串，不能代替上面三个守卫。
错误类（`RpcError`、`RpcRemoteError`、`RpcTimeoutError` 等）只作为类型导出。唯一可构造的运行时类是 `RpcLifecycleError`，供持有自身释放状态的消费方（例如 Store Worker）报告生命周期失败。

blocks.text: 公开错误形状使用 `IRpcError`；平台与拓扑值域使用 `IRpcPlatformValue`、`IRpcTransportTopologyValue`。工厂组合类型从实际调用结果推导，认证 nonce 由认证 owner 内部生成。
按 `(source, code)` 分支，不要匹配 `message`。跨 Worker、iframe 或模块副本时，用 `isRpcErrorInstance`、`isRpcRemoteError`、`isRpcTimeoutError` 判断错误族，而不是 `instanceof`。全部错误码及处理建议见 USEGUIDE 第 10 节。

symbols.purpose: Stable semantic failure codes owned by the runtime-neutral Core execution layer. The stable values below select actual contract behavior; declarations alone grant no capability.
symbols.core:
providerGenerationMismatch: PROVIDER_GENERATION_MISMATCH: accepted caller/provider generation no longer matches the task; select the actual binding again.
providerGenerationRetired: PROVIDER_GENERATION_RETIRED: an admitted forwarded execution retired with its exact generation; never replay it.
forwardLoop: FORWARD_LOOP: signed route revisits this or the selected next Host; choose another route.
forwardHopLimit: FORWARD_HOP_LIMIT: three forwarding nodes were already visited; use a direct channel or shorter route.
middlewareDuplicated: MIDDLEWARE_DUPLICATED: names repeat in the construction tuple; assign one unique name per middleware.
middlewareMissing: MIDDLEWARE_MISSING: the operation requires an actually installed connect, abort, ping or other middleware capability.
capabilityUnsupported: CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED: actual peer agreement does not support the requested runtime mode or capability.
invalidConfig: INVALID_CONFIG: factory, component, transport or transform configuration is invalid; inspect detail and correct local inputs.
probeFailed: PROBE_FAILED: a diagnostic emit/describe/redact callback failed; business execution remains isolated.
providerDuplicated: PROVIDER_DUPLICATED: provide registered a method that already has an owner; change the method or combine providers.
protocolInvalid: PROTOCOL_INVALID: codec/protocol/envelope behavior or correlated control is invalid; inspect original cause.
contractInvalid: CONTRACT_INVALID: method correlation, direction or contract identity fields violate the actual request contract.
payloadInvalid: PAYLOAD_INVALID: data, physical batch encoding or error projection violates its selected codec boundary.
providerNotFound: PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: the receiving endpoint has no registered provider for the requested method.
providerNotSettled: PROVIDER_NOT_SETTLED: a request provider returned without an explicit success or failed result.
callbackFailed: CALLBACK_FAILED: a construction or diagnostic callback failed; native mutable errors retain type, stack and identity, foreign semantic identities stay unchanged, and other values remain on cause.
internal: INTERNAL: provider threw unexpectedly; original error stays in local diagnostics while the peer receives a redacted failure.
targetUnknown: TARGET_UNKNOWN: target or receiver is unresolved, inactive or outside the original selected binding.
targetNotIdentifiable: TARGET_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: anonymous broadcast group cannot satisfy a per-instance operation.
endpointDisposed: ENDPOINT_DISPOSED: an operation used a disposed endpoint; construct a new owner instead.
cancelled: CANCELLED: actual caller AbortSignal cancelled the local send; remote effects may already have occurred.
deadlineExceeded: DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: the local operation deadline expired; treat this transmission attempt as failed.
contextExpired: PROVIDER_CONTEXT_EXPIRED: success or failed was called after the original provider lifetime ended; no wire effect is produced.
transport: TRANSPORT: actual physical send or terminal channel failed; preserve original transport evidence before choosing recovery. The code alone never proves nonexecution; retry requires independent evidence or idempotency/outcome reconciliation.
authenticationFailed: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: signing, verification, encryption, decryption or original replay binding failed; details stay local.
schemaInvalid: SCHEMA_INVALID: params/result parse rejected the method data; inspect normalized issues and original cause.
capabilityConflict: CAPABILITY_CONFLICT: selected middleware/features publish conflicting keys or an ambiguous runtime instance.
overloaded: OVERLOADED: execution/replay/discovery/chunk capacity refused new work; inspect its independent reason channel.
streamResultUnknown: STREAM_RESULT_UNKNOWN: transport may have sent a stream frame before rejecting; open a new stream without replaying items.
chunkInvalid: CHUNK_INVALID: physical fragment grammar is invalid; hooks observe it and the frame is not replayed.
propertyReadFailed: PROPERTY_READ_FAILED: a getter/proxy failed without a valid synchronous reporter, or that reporter threw.
idempotencyResultUnavailable: IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE: business already ran but result was not retained; resolve outcome before another attempt.
stringConversionFailed: STRING_CONVERSION_FAILED: conversion or its required synchronous reporter failed; preserve original cause.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.

members.description: Two middleware declarations in the same factory use the same `name`. * * The installer rejects before installing any middleware. The caller gives each middleware a * unique `name`. Enforces the duplicate singleton middleware creation rule in §7.1.

members.name: middlewareMissing
members.description: An operation requires a capability that is not installed. * * Examples include creating an endpoint without `connect`, calling `ping()` without `ping`, or * passing `signal` without `abort`. The caller installs the corresponding middleware.

members.name: capabilityUnsupported
members.description: A Runtime API operation requires a mode or capability absent from the actual peer agreement. * Enforces D5/D42; choose a supported method/mode rather than retrying the same operation.

members.name: invalidConfig
members.description: A factory, middleware, or transport descriptor or configuration field is invalid. Replay r12 * also rejects encrypt-only configuration, unavailable entropy, and exhausted counters. * * This code identifies argument and configuration failures. The caller corrects the configuration * using `detail` before retrying.

members.name: probeFailed
members.description: A probe emit, describe or redact callback fails. Probe-core reports it with the original cause * and isolates it from business execution; callers should repair or disable the diagnostic sink.

members.name: providerDuplicated
members.description: `provide()` registers the same method twice. * * A provider does not replace another provider with the same name. The caller combines the * implementations or changes the name.

members.name: protocolInvalid
members.description: A protocol codec, scheme, or envelope is invalid, the caller cannot reconstruct a response * error, or a provider receives an invalid abort payload. This is the base code for * `RpcProtocolError`. * * The caller checks that the protocol configuration matches the peer scheme. If the payload is * already sent or cancellation has taken effect, inspect the peer rather than retrying the same * message.

members.name: contractInvalid
members.description: Contract fields, direction, or request/response correlation are invalid. This is the base code * for `RpcContractError`. * * The caller checks `version`, `identifier`, sender/target direction, or `taskId`/method * correlation.

members.name: payloadInvalid
members.description: A codec payload violates its input rules, or sender-side error serialization degrades a read or * data projection. This is the base code for `RpcSerializationError` and `RpcChunkError`. * Physical batch shape/encoding failures preserve the contract cause; malformed semantic members * are reported individually without discarding valid siblings. * * The caller checks the data, codec, or thrown value. Do not retry the same payload if it is * already sent or cancellation has taken effect.

members.name: providerNotFound
members.description: The provider executor cannot find a provider for the target method (`Provider not found`). * * The caller checks whether `provide()` registers the method. Do not retry the failed lookup. * This is the wire code for an inbound provider lookup failure.

members.name: providerNotSettled
members.description: A non-dispatch provider does not return `ctx.success()` or `ctx.failed()`. * * The caller ensures every non-dispatch branch explicitly returns a result, or selects dispatch * if that is intended.

members.name: internal
members.description: A provider throws an unhandled exception. This is the standard code for an `INTERNAL` response. * * Only local hooks receive the redacted original exception. The peer receives `RpcRemoteError` * with code `INTERNAL`.

members.name: targetUnknown
members.description: A target or receiver is unresolved, inactive, or outside the current binding. * * The caller checks whether `targetId` is registered or discovered, or whether `receiverSelector` * returns an unknown receiver.

members.name: targetNotIdentifiable
members.description: An operation requires an individual receiver, but the target is an anonymous BroadcastChannel * group. * * The caller configures `uniqueTargetId` and `identifier` before pinning, or avoids per-instance * operations on the group.

members.name: endpointDisposed
members.description: An endpoint operation runs after disposal (`RpcLifecycleError`). * * The caller creates a new endpoint instead of reusing the closed instance.

members.name: cancelled
members.description: The caller's `AbortSignal` cancels a local send (`RpcAbortError`). * * The caller handles this cooperative cancellation separately from remote failures.

members.name: deadlineExceeded
members.description: A local deadline expires (`RpcTimeoutError`). * * The caller checks target reachability and the timeout duration. Treat the request failure as * the result of this transmission attempt.

members.name: contextExpired
members.description: `ctx.success()` or `ctx.failed()` runs after the provider task ends. * * The expired result produces no wire effects. The caller keeps response logic within the * provider's synchronous or awaited lifetime.

members.name: transport
members.description: A transport send fails, a terminal event occurs, or the transport closes (`RpcTransportError`). * * The code alone does not establish whether a send already executed. Retry only with independent * evidence that it did not execute, or use the existing idempotency/outcome reconciliation.

members.name: authenticationFailed
members.description: A per-frame authentication transform fails during encryption, signing, verification, or * decryption (`RpcAuthenticationError`). Replay r12 rejects missing/invalid binding, duplicate * counters and untrusted physical sessions. * * The caller checks key and algorithm configuration. Failure details are not sent back to the * peer.

members.name: schemaInvalid
members.description: Method parameters or results violate the contract schema (`RpcSchemaValidationError`). * * The caller corrects the data using `data.issues` rather than retrying the same invalid data.

members.name: capabilityConflict
members.description: A capability is published twice, or a frozen capability registry receives another write. I28 * D8/D11 also rejects folded Feature method collisions and ambiguous runtime instances. * * The caller checks middleware for duplicate declarations of reserved capabilities. This is a * configuration error.

members.name: overloaded
members.description: A local capacity limit rejects new work in provider admission, the replay ledger, discovery * waiters, outbound IDs, or chunks. * * The caller reduces concurrency, shortens TTL, or increases capacity. This signals backpressure * rather than a logic error.

members.name: streamResultUnknown
members.description: A stream frame may have been sent before its transport rejected; the caller must open a fresh * stream and never replay delivered values (streaming R7).

members.name: chunkInvalid
members.description: A chunk frame has an invalid format. This is the base code for `RpcChunkError`. * * The caller checks chunk configuration (`chunkSize` ≥ 4) and the peer implementation. An invalid * frame only invokes hooks and is not retried.

members.name: propertyReadFailed
members.description: A getter or Proxy throws during `safeRead` without a synchronous reporter, or the reporter * itself throws (R11). The caller repairs the input or supplies a synchronous `report` at a * boundary that owns a diagnostic sink.

members.name: idempotencyResultUnavailable
members.description: A keyed call already executed but its result was not retained for replay. The caller must * resolve the outcome before issuing another non-idempotent attempt.

members.name: stringConversionFailed
members.description: A string conversion throws without a synchronous reporter, or its reporter throws (cleanup * R12). The caller must repair the input or provide a synchronous diagnostic sink.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Stable semantic failure codes owned by the runtime-neutral Core execution layer. The stable values below select actual contract behavior; declarations alone grant no capability.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import RpcCoreErrorCode from @migaia/rpc-core, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use RpcCoreErrorCode when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when RpcCoreErrorCode does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

items: `isRpcErrorInstance`、`isRpcRemoteError`、`isRpcTimeoutError` 按稳定字段判断，跨 Worker、iframe、模块副本都有效；不要依赖 `instanceof`。

blocks.text: 所有错误都是原生 `Error`（或子类），附带 `source` 与 `code`。按 `(source, code)` 分支，不要匹配 `message`。

items: `isRpcErrorInstance`、`isRpcRemoteError`、`isRpcTimeoutError` 按稳定字段判断，跨 Worker、iframe、模块副本都有效；不要依赖 `instanceof`。
`isRpcError` 只检查 `code` 是否为字符串，不能代替上面三个守卫。
错误类（`RpcError`、`RpcRemoteError`、`RpcTimeoutError` 等）只作为类型导出。唯一可构造的运行时类是 `RpcLifecycleError`，供持有自身释放状态的消费方（例如 Store Worker）报告生命周期失败。

blocks.text: `serializeRpcError` / `deserializeRpcError`（包根）在 Core 层传递错误时使用：它们保留 Core 的脱敏与转发路由信息。错误树的结构、校验与 JSON-RPC 映射见 rpc-contract USEGUIDE 第 9 节。
对端抛出的业务错误会还原为原生类型并保留 `message`、`stack` 与 `cause` 链。来自对端的 source / code 只用于诊断，不会被当作本地库的错误身份，也不授予任何控制权限。

Absent: no caller cancellation.

offer: Local rpc-contract IRpcHandshakeOffer proposal; received I/O determines accepted capabilities.

governor: Actual original connection policy for call-rate, payload, repeated-timeout, idle and violation limits; it borrows original provider admission.
Absent: no extra connection governor.
scope: Genuine scope returned by this adapter scope method; borrowed across peers and closed by its caller after peers close.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
postMessage: Calls the actual native postMessage and forwards the exact ordered transfer list.
postMessage.message: Original native-supported message value.
postMessage.transfer: Optional original native transferable references.
postMessage.transferList: Optional original native transferable references.
Returns after native postMessage; synchronous clone/transfer failures propagate.
start: Starts native MessagePort delivery without replacing existing event listeners.
Native delivery is enabled; no RPC connection is inferred.
close: Calls the original native port close operation; its actual physical owner determines idempotency and errors.
Native close completes or throws its original failure.
addEventListener: Registers an additional native event callback without taking a mutable onmessage slot.
addEventListener.type: Actual supported native message/messageerror/error event name for this structural port.
addEventListener.listener: Synchronous callback receives the original native event, returns void; native dispatch owns invocation.
Original event callback is registered.
removeEventListener: Removes the exact original event callback without removing other registrations.
removeEventListener.type: Same native event name passed when registering.
removeEventListener.listener: Same original callback reference passed to registration.
Native removal completes or throws its original failure.
on: Adds an actual EventEmitter message, messageerror or close listener.
on.event: Supported native message/messageerror/close event name.
on.listener: Synchronous callback receives original message or optional original error; returns void.
Native emitter registration result is not used by Core.
off: Removes an exact EventEmitter listener registration.
off.event: Original supported native event name used when adding.
off.listener: Exact original listener reference used when adding.
Native emitter removal result is not used by Core.
onError: Subscribes to original physical/read/terminal failures without treating them as application provider results.
onError.listener: Application callback receives original unknown error, returns void; secondary failure is retained by the adapter reporter boundary.
Removal releases this failure observer only.
observe: Installs original physical observation; replacing it retires the preceding observation generation without acquiring lifecycle ownership.
observe.probe: Actual IRpcCarrierProbe port supplied by the installed endpoint emitter.
Disposer retires only this observation generation, including when the same probe was later reinstalled.
listenerCount: Reports actual native message listener count when the raw EventEmitter supports it.
listenerCount.event: The original message event name.
Actual native listener count.
once: Registers an actual one-shot close observation on the native resource.
once.event: The original native close event name.
once.listener: Application zero-argument synchronous close callback returning void.
Native registration result is not consumed by Core.

blocks.text: Endpoint 用户在激活前安装 `probePlugin`。Peer 用户只需传入 `probe`。Core 在激活后交付一次 descriptor；只有载体实际提供 `observe` 才调用它，释放函数由现有 resource scope 在关闭时执行。Peer 阶段覆盖 handshake、ready、exit、restart、directory 与 closing。冷 `subscribeProbeStages` listener 抛错时，`setStages` 仍先通知其余 listener，使已安装 emitter 采用新 mask，再传播 `CALLBACK_FAILED`；单个可附码原生错误保留身份。
`setStages([])` 暂停后不再构造所选事件；关闭后不再发送事件。

configuration.name: scheduler
configuration.description: Memory transport delivery and deferred remote/governor control work use the existing scheduler contract. Default scheduling retains native microtasks. `createMemoryTransportPair({ scheduler })` controls only pair delivery; endpoint deadline clocks remain a separate constructor choice. Injected manual clocks must advance zero-time work for deferred reconciliation, departure notifications and policy close. Ordinary deadline `schedule(0)` behavior is unchanged.
configuration.descriptionEn: Memory transport delivery and deferred remote/governor control work use the existing scheduler contract. Default scheduling retains native microtasks. `createMemoryTransportPair({ scheduler })` controls only pair delivery; endpoint deadline clocks remain a separate constructor choice. Injected manual clocks must advance zero-time work for deferred reconciliation, departure notifications and policy close. Ordinary deadline `schedule(0)` behavior is unchanged.

symbols.name: IControlSurface
symbols.signature: export type IControlSurface = Partial<Pick<IRpcEndpoint, 'ping' | 'pingAll' | 'announceClose'>>;
symbols.purpose: Selected optional control projection contains announceClose and capability-dependent ping/pingAll from the original control owner.
symbols.core:
announceClose: Announces a bounded drain window to one peer while leaving actual physical close with its owning adapter.
announceClose.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
announceClose.options: Caller drainMs duration and optional receiverId from discovery; this is a relative peer announcement.
Resolves when the close control is sent; it does not await remote resource disposal.
ping: Checks one actual receiver liveness; requires installed ping capability and actual negotiated support.
ping.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
ping.receiverId: Specific receiver identifier returned by discovery candidates or connect.getServerList; never invent an instance address.
ping.options: Optional IRpcPingOptions with local signal and deadline override.
Promise<boolean> for the observed reply; disposal settles an active ping as false. Calling after disposal or without ping capability throws its coded error. Ping cancellation does not require abort middleware.

symbols.purpose: Selected outbound projection contains requests, fanout, dispatch, group/outcome and local hooks without provider or discovery controls.
symbols.core:
send: Sends a correlated scalar request to the selected receiver and waits for one actual provider result.
send.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
send.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
send.data: Application request payload validated by the installed contract/codec.
send.options: Optional ISendOptions supplied by the caller; timeout, cancellation, transfer, idempotency and trace remain explicit.
Promise of provider data; remote business failure, cancellation, deadline, transport or lifecycle failure rejects with its native coded error. A synchronous UUID admission failure releases operation signal listeners; ordinary send cancellation keeps RpcAbortError.
sendAll: Sends the same scalar method to the statically configured target seeds and keeps each target success/failure separately.
sendAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
sendAll.data: Application payload sent independently to every selected target.
sendAll.options: Caller ISendOptions applied to the selected fan-out operations.
IRpcFanoutResult maps receiver/target keys to fulfilled data or original rejected errors.
dispatch: Sends a legacy one-way event without awaiting business completion; pair with on on the receiving endpoint.
dispatch.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
dispatch.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatch.data: Application event payload for the receiving listener.
Returns void once dispatch is initiated; failures are contained in endpoint hooks.
dispatchAll: Dispatches one event to the statically configured target seeds without waiting for business listeners.
dispatchAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatchAll.data: Application event payload for each selected target.
Returns void after scheduling selected dispatches; hooks observe failures.
group: Reserves every request-only step before execution, then runs in order until first failure; successful earlier effects are not rolled back.
group.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
group.steps: Application nonempty method/payload array admitted as IRpcRuntimeGroupSteps.
group.options: Optional IRpcRuntimeGroupOptions with actual ordering/cancellation/idempotency and local send controls.
Promise of actual step outcomes; unsupported native group capability rejects before dispatch.
outcome: Reads an original logical key outcome from the provider store without executing providers again.
outcome.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
outcome.idempotencyKey: Original application-issued key used for the same earlier logical operation.
IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult reports pending/done/unknown and store continuity; unknown never proves nonexecution.
hooks: Local diagnostic subscription facade; hooks.on receives IRpcHookEvent and returns an unsubscriber.

send.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
send.data: Application request payload validated by the installed contract/codec.
send.options: Optional ISendOptions supplied by the caller; timeout, cancellation, transfer, idempotency and trace remain explicit.
Promise of provider data; remote business failure, cancellation, deadline, transport or lifecycle failure rejects with its native coded error. A synchronous UUID admission failure releases operation signal listeners; ordinary send cancellation keeps RpcAbortError.
sendAll: Sends the same scalar method to the statically configured target seeds and keeps each target success/failure separately.
sendAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
sendAll.data: Application payload sent independently to every selected target.
sendAll.options: Caller ISendOptions applied to the selected fan-out operations.
IRpcFanoutResult maps receiver/target keys to fulfilled data or original rejected errors.
dispatch: Sends a legacy one-way event without awaiting business completion; pair with on on the receiving endpoint.
dispatch.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
dispatch.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatch.data: Application event payload for the receiving listener.
Returns void once dispatch is initiated; failures are contained in endpoint hooks.
dispatchAll: Dispatches one event to the statically configured target seeds without waiting for business listeners.
dispatchAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatchAll.data: Application event payload for each selected target.
Returns void after scheduling selected dispatches; hooks observe failures.
group: Reserves every request-only step before execution, then runs in order until first failure; successful earlier effects are not rolled back.
group.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
group.steps: Application nonempty method/payload array admitted as IRpcRuntimeGroupSteps.
group.options: Optional IRpcRuntimeGroupOptions with actual ordering/cancellation/idempotency and local send controls.
Promise of actual step outcomes; unsupported native group capability rejects before dispatch.
outcome: Reads an original logical key outcome from the provider store without executing providers again.
outcome.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
outcome.idempotencyKey: Original application-issued key used for the same earlier logical operation.
IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult reports pending/done/unknown and store continuity; unknown never proves nonexecution.
announceClose: Announces a bounded drain window to one peer while leaving actual physical close with its owning adapter.
announceClose.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
announceClose.options: Caller drainMs duration and optional receiverId from discovery; this is a relative peer announcement.
Resolves when the close control is sent; it does not await remote resource disposal.
ping: Checks one actual receiver liveness; requires installed ping capability and actual negotiated support.
ping.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
ping.receiverId: Specific receiver identifier returned by discovery candidates or connect.getServerList; never invent an instance address.
ping.options: Optional IRpcPingOptions with local signal and deadline override.
Promise<boolean> for the observed reply; disposal settles an active ping as false. Calling after disposal or without ping capability throws its coded error. Ping cancellation does not require abort middleware.
pingAll: Checks liveness of the statically configured target seeds and retains individual success/failure results.
IRpcFanoutResult<boolean> keyed by the selected actual receivers.
connect: Connection/discovery controls derived from the actual middleware tuple; manual mode exposes query and registration operations.
discovery: Read-only candidate listing and explicit receiver pin controls sharing the canonical discovery owner.
hooks: Local diagnostic subscription facade; hooks.on receives IRpcHookEvent and returns an unsubscriber.
dispose: Idempotently stops admission, drains owned work and releases middleware/adapter resources in the canonical lifecycle order.
Promise resolves after disposal; cleanup failures remain reachable through standard cause/errors traversal, including all failures in the same batch; future operations fail ENDPOINT_DISPOSED.
sendOneWay: Sends an application one-way message and waits for actual physical completion; pair with on at the receiving endpoint.
sendOneWay.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
sendOneWay.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
sendOneWay.data: Original application notification payload validated by the installed contract/codec.
sendOneWay.options: Optional IRpcOneWayOptions with explicit local signal/deadline and actual transfer references.
Promise<void> settles on physical send; it never confirms listener execution or a provider business result.
id: Application-assigned stable local endpoint identifier included in outgoing routes.
scheduler: Application monotonic IScheduler shared by endpoint deadlines and PluginHost; now must be finite nonnegative milliseconds.
systemScheduler uses host monotonic time and timers.
wallClock: Application IWallClock supplies only wire sentAt and hook timestamps as nonnegative safe-integer epoch milliseconds.
systemWallClock uses the host epoch clock.
transport: Actual application adapter selected by top-level config or native connect middleware; native source evidence remains adapter-owned.
Absent: use the selected connect middleware transport; otherwise construction fails.
protocol: Canonical semantic IRpcProtocol descriptor selected independently of codec encoding.
rpcProtocolV1 is the default canonical protocol.
codec: ICodec from @migaia/serialize/codec whose encoded output exactly matches the selected framer input.
identityCodecV1 preserves the canonical semantic envelope.
framer: IRpcFramer from rpc-contract/framing whose actual output is accepted by the selected transport.
messageFramerV1 uses complete unfragmented messages.
targetIds: Optional known-peer base identifiers issued by application deployment configuration; automatic discovery can resolve more later.
Empty seed list; discovery remains available.
provider: Application map of unique method names to IRpcProvider callbacks installed before endpoint construction returns.
Absent: register providers later through provide.
providerLimits: Optional IRpcProviderLimits applied to the existing shared execution/replay admission owner.
Global 256, per-peer 64, replay per-peer 1024.
idempotency: Optional actual original result store and authenticated scope function for keyed provider work.
Absent: use the endpoint-owned canonical keyed replay policy.
idempotency.store: Optional caller-held IRpcIdempotencyStore shared only across actual intended sessions.
Absent: use the original endpoint-local store.
idempotency.scope: Synchronous application callback receives actual admitted token and senderId, returns a stable scope string; it must not treat arbitrary wire claims as identity.
Absent: canonical admitted-session scope is used.
replay: Outbound active identifiers plus settled tombstone retention, separate from business result storage.
Use maxEntries 4096 and ttlMs 310000.
replay.maxEntries: Maximum retained outbound request identities including active operations and settled tombstones.
`4096` retained outbound identities.
replay.ttlMs: Scheduler milliseconds to retain settled outbound request identity tombstones.
`310000` milliseconds after settlement.
middlewares: Required ordered finite tuple of actual middleware definitions installed atomically by PluginHost.
features: Optional finite immutable tuple of actual native IRpcFeature roots; dependencies remain private and only selected public surfaces are projected.
Empty tuple adds no user-defined features.
construction: Caller construction cancellation/deadline; failure still rolls back every installed middleware in original lifecycle order.
Absent: no caller abort or construction deadline.
construction.signal: Optional caller cancellation signal controlling construction and its complete rollback.
Absent: construction has an uncancelled native signal.
construction.timeoutMs: Finite nonnegative construction deadline or false to disable; rollback retains the primary failure and cleanup failures.
Absent or false: no construction deadline.
Disable only the construction deadline.

onEvent: Subscribes to frozen local backlog snapshots; observer failure is host-reported and cannot change send settlement.
onEvent.listener: Synchronous application callback receives IIpcBacklogEvent and returns void.

close: Idempotently closes admission and rejects queued work with the original reason; active physical I/O keeps its own settlement.
close.reason: Optional original shutdown failure issued by the connection owner.
No later work can be admitted; existing physical send is not falsely declared cancelled.

guidance.heading: 13.2 View 生命周期与内容捕获

blocks.text: 每个 emitter 复用固定形状的 `IRpcProbeEventView`。只能在同步 `emit` 中读取它；需要稍后读取时使用快照：

`snapshotProbeEvent` 是显式复制请求（SC9c）：复制并冻结顶层字段，保留 `detail`、`error` 与 `content` 的引用和所有权。它防止复用 view 改写快照的顶层元数据，不固定这些引用对象的内容。按照 SC9，普通捕获与存储保留引用；调用方发送后修改 `detail`、错误或未被转移的 content 对象，后续读取仍可见修改。只有实际 transfer 会分离的字节缓冲、真实 codec/序列化边界（SC9b），或显式快照 API 才复制必要数据。未知 `sizeBytes`、未分块的 chunk 字段、非批次的 `members` 与未结算的 `durationMs` 都使用 `-1`。
`protected` 仅在认证保护路径存在时产生；没有该能力的路径不会伪造该阶段。内容捕获包括 protected 内容都必须显式启用。Descriptor 的 `stageMask` 描述 endpoint 能产生且当前已订阅的阶段，不证明所有路径都会经历每个阶段。

`sizeBytes` 只读取已知的原生字节 backing/view 长度。所有字符串与 opaque container 均为 `-1`，包括 string transport；metadata 不扫描、编码或规范化 payload。Byte carrier 复用其现成 frame 长度。各载体与 Core 复用 `adapter/internal-advanced` 的 `carrierSizeBytes` owner。

`setStages([])` 允许暂停，之后可以设置其它已知阶段。它更新私有状态的阶段选择，保留定义时的 `captureMask`；host 上不可写的 `stageMask` 仍为初始定义值，独立 handle 的 `stageMask` getter 反映当前私有值。非法阶段会抛出 `INVALID_CONFIG` 并保留旧 mask。`readProbeStages(probe)` 读取当前有效 mask；`subscribeProbeStages(probe, listener)` 在每次实际变更后通知一次，返回可重复调用的释放函数。两者用于冷控制边界，不加入消息热路径。

Endpoint 用户在激活前安装 `probePlugin`。Peer 用户只需传入 `probe`。Core 在激活后交付一次 descriptor；只有载体实际提供 `observe` 才调用它，释放函数由现有 resource scope 在关闭时执行。Peer 阶段覆盖 handshake、ready、exit、restart、directory 与 closing。冷 `subscribeProbeStages` listener 抛错时，`setStages` 仍先通知其余 listener，使已安装 emitter 采用新 mask，再传播 `CALLBACK_FAILED`；单个可附码原生错误保留身份。
`setStages([])` 暂停后不再构造所选事件；关闭后不再发送事件。

guidance.heading: 13.2 View 生命周期与内容捕获

blocks.text: 每个 emitter 复用固定形状的 `IRpcProbeEventView`。只能在同步 `emit` 中读取它；需要稍后读取时使用快照：

`snapshotProbeEvent` 是显式复制请求（SC9c）：复制并冻结顶层字段，保留 `detail`、`error` 与 `content` 的引用和所有权。它防止复用 view 改写快照的顶层元数据，不固定这些引用对象的内容。按照 SC9，普通捕获与存储保留引用；调用方发送后修改 `detail`、错误或未被转移的 content 对象，后续读取仍可见修改。只有实际 transfer 会分离的字节缓冲、真实 codec/序列化边界（SC9b），或显式快照 API 才复制必要数据。未知 `sizeBytes`、未分块的 chunk 字段、非批次的 `members` 与未结算的 `durationMs` 都使用 `-1`。
`protected` 仅在认证保护路径存在时产生；没有该能力的路径不会伪造该阶段。内容捕获包括 protected 内容都必须显式启用。Descriptor 的 `stageMask` 描述 endpoint 能产生且当前已订阅的阶段，不证明所有路径都会经历每个阶段。

`sizeBytes` 只读取已知的原生字节 backing/view 长度。所有字符串与 opaque container 均为 `-1`，包括 string transport；metadata 不扫描、编码或规范化 payload。Byte carrier 复用其现成 frame 长度。各载体与 Core 复用 `adapter/internal-advanced` 的 `carrierSizeBytes` owner。

`setStages([])` 允许暂停，之后可以设置其它已知阶段。它更新私有状态的阶段选择，保留定义时的 `captureMask`；host 上不可写的 `stageMask` 仍为初始定义值，独立 handle 的 `stageMask` getter 反映当前私有值。非法阶段会抛出 `INVALID_CONFIG` 并保留旧 mask。`readProbeStages(probe)` 读取当前有效 mask；`subscribeProbeStages(probe, listener)` 在每次实际变更后通知一次，返回可重复调用的释放函数。两者用于冷控制边界，不加入消息热路径。

guidance.heading: 13.2 View 生命周期与内容捕获

blocks.text: 每个 emitter 复用固定形状的 `IRpcProbeEventView`。只能在同步 `emit` 中读取它；需要稍后读取时使用快照：

`snapshotProbeEvent` 是显式复制请求（SC9c）：复制并冻结顶层字段，保留 `detail`、`error` 与 `content` 的引用和所有权。它防止复用 view 改写快照的顶层元数据，不固定这些引用对象的内容。按照 SC9，普通捕获与存储保留引用；调用方发送后修改 `detail`、错误或未被转移的 content 对象，后续读取仍可见修改。只有实际 transfer 会分离的字节缓冲、真实 codec/序列化边界（SC9b），或显式快照 API 才复制必要数据。未知 `sizeBytes`、未分块的 chunk 字段、非批次的 `members` 与未结算的 `durationMs` 都使用 `-1`。
`protected` 仅在认证保护路径存在时产生；没有该能力的路径不会伪造该阶段。内容捕获包括 protected 内容都必须显式启用。Descriptor 的 `stageMask` 描述 endpoint 能产生且当前已订阅的阶段，不证明所有路径都会经历每个阶段。

`sizeBytes` 只读取已知的原生字节 backing/view 长度。所有字符串与 opaque container 均为 `-1`，包括 string transport；metadata 不扫描、编码或规范化 payload。Byte carrier 复用其现成 frame 长度。各载体与 Core 复用 `adapter/internal-advanced` 的 `carrierSizeBytes` owner。

`setStages([])` 允许暂停，之后可以设置其它已知阶段。它更新私有状态的阶段选择，保留定义时的 `captureMask`；host 上不可写的 `stageMask` 仍为初始定义值，独立 handle 的 `stageMask` getter 反映当前私有值。非法阶段会抛出 `INVALID_CONFIG` 并保留旧 mask。`readProbeStages(probe)` 读取当前有效 mask；`subscribeProbeStages(probe, listener)` 在每次实际变更后通知一次，返回可重复调用的释放函数。两者用于冷控制边界，不加入消息热路径。

Endpoint 用户在激活前安装 `probePlugin`。Peer 用户只需传入 `probe`。Core 在激活后交付一次 descriptor；只有载体实际提供 `observe` 才调用它，释放函数由现有 resource scope 在关闭时执行。Peer 阶段覆盖 handshake、ready、exit、restart、directory 与 closing。冷 `subscribeProbeStages` listener 抛错时，`setStages` 仍先通知其余 listener，使已安装 emitter 采用新 mask，再传播 `CALLBACK_FAILED`；单个可附码原生错误保留身份。
`setStages([])` 暂停后不再构造所选事件；关闭后不再发送事件。

symbols.name: createProviderEndpoint
symbols.signature: export declare const createProviderEndpoint: IPublicCallable;
symbols.purpose: Creates provider registration with its inseparable original outbound closure; callbacks use actual inbound execution contexts.
symbols.core:
config: Application IRpcFactoryConfig whose actual protocol/codec/framer/transport types satisfy both directed pipeline edges; middlewares is the actual finite installation tuple.
Promise of the selected endpoint surface; invalid inputs fail before publication, failed construction rolls back and preserves original/cleanup causes. An unclassified middleware install failure gains CALLBACK_FAILED without replacing mutable native type/stack; foreign semantic identities stay intact and immutable values remain on cause.
send: Sends a correlated scalar request to the selected receiver and waits for one actual provider result.
send.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
send.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
send.data: Application request payload validated by the installed contract/codec.
send.options: Optional ISendOptions supplied by the caller; timeout, cancellation, transfer, idempotency and trace remain explicit.
Promise of provider data; remote business failure, cancellation, deadline, transport or lifecycle failure rejects with its native coded error. A synchronous UUID admission failure releases operation signal listeners; ordinary send cancellation keeps RpcAbortError.
sendAll: Sends the same scalar method to the statically configured target seeds and keeps each target success/failure separately.
sendAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
sendAll.data: Application payload sent independently to every selected target.
sendAll.options: Caller ISendOptions applied to the selected fan-out operations.
IRpcFanoutResult maps receiver/target keys to fulfilled data or original rejected errors.
dispatch: Sends a legacy one-way event without awaiting business completion; pair with on on the receiving endpoint.
dispatch.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
dispatch.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatch.data: Application event payload for the receiving listener.
Returns void once dispatch is initiated; failures are contained in endpoint hooks.
dispatchAll: Dispatches one event to the statically configured target seeds without waiting for business listeners.
dispatchAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatchAll.data: Application event payload for each selected target.
Returns void after scheduling selected dispatches; hooks observe failures.
group: Reserves every request-only step before execution, then runs in order until first failure; successful earlier effects are not rolled back.
group.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
group.steps: Application nonempty method/payload array admitted as IRpcRuntimeGroupSteps.
group.options: Optional IRpcRuntimeGroupOptions with actual ordering/cancellation/idempotency and local send controls.
Promise of actual step outcomes; unsupported native group capability rejects before dispatch.
outcome: Reads an original logical key outcome from the provider store without executing providers again.
outcome.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
outcome.idempotencyKey: Original application-issued key used for the same earlier logical operation.
IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult reports pending/done/unknown and store continuity; unknown never proves nonexecution.
hooks: Local diagnostic subscription facade; hooks.on receives IRpcHookEvent and returns an unsubscriber.
provide: Registers one provider for a unique method name; duplicate registration throws PROVIDER_DUPLICATED.
provide.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
provide.provider: Application callback receives IRpcContext and returns context.success or context.failed synchronously or asynchronously. Legacy ordinary throws usually become INTERNAL; trusted wire summaries and SCHEMA_INVALID retain public classification. Runtime operations serialize the original failure.
The same endpoint for chaining; disposal rejects new registrations.
on: Registers a one-way event listener; callbacks receive IRpcContext and async failures are observed through endpoint hooks.
on.event: Application event name matching the sender dispatch method.
