symbols.signature: export declare function createCoroutinePlugin<TRemote = Record<never, never>, const TProvide extends IRuntimePeerProvide = Record<never, never>, const TName extends string = string, const TExpose extends readonly string[] = readonly [], THost = unknown>(options: (ICoroutineParentOptions | ICoroutineChildOptions) & Readonly<{ name: TName; provide?: TProvide; expose?: TExpose & (unknown extends THost ? unknown : readonly IRuntimeExpose<IRuntimeRegistry<THost>>[]); }>): ReturnType<typeof createRuntimePlugin> & IRuntimePluginTyping<TRemote, TProvide, TName, TExpose, 'coroutine'>;
symbols.purpose: Creates a parent task owner or child connection plugin; the two modes must be used together through the genuine task connect token.
symbols.core:
options: Application name and provided methods plus exactly one parent task or child connect token.
Cold plugin for the coroutine Host outlet; parent disposal cooperatively stops its task, child disposal closes only its connection.
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.
No result is used; reporter errors are contained by the reporting boundary.
Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
authentication.encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
authentication.encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
authentication.encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.
Omitted: this stage is absent; signing/verification must still be configured and encryption/decryption must be supplied together.
authentication.decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
authentication.decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
authentication.decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Recovered replay-bound authentication envelope or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with the original cause.
authentication.sign: Outbound sync/async signing runs after optional encryption and returns the complete protected frame representation. Signing and verification are required even without encryption.
authentication.sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.
authentication.sign.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.
authentication.verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
authentication.verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
authentication.verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Authenticated inner value or its Promise, passed to decrypt when configured; reject or throw on invalid signatures. Local reporting retains the original verification failure, which may be sensitive; the peer receives a sanitized summary. Other returned values still undergo envelope/replay validation.
authentication.encodedType: Declared protected-output domain must match the next physical pipeline edge. Encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify are complete pairs, at least signing is required, and encryption additionally requires signing.
any: do not impose a declared protected-output value category.
Leave the declared output domain unconstrained; transforms may still change representation.
Declare that the protected output is text for the subsequent pipeline edge.
Declare that the protected output is a byte array for the subsequent pipeline edge.
connect: Child-only token supplied by the current parent task context; arbitrary objects and tokens from other ownership paths are rejected.
Omitted only in parent mode, which requires task.
name: Caller-selected nonempty registration name copied when constructing the cold plugin; use the same name when addressing the installed runtime outlet.
expose: Distinct nonempty paths explicitly exposing current Host feature methods, runtime connection routes or the reserved host control entry. Only this snapshotted whitelist becomes remotely callable.
Omitted: an empty whitelist; only provide methods are published.
host: The same actual PluginHost handle into which this plugin is installed, supplying use, unUse, plugin and revision for explicit host exposure.
Omitted: allowed unless expose contains host; explicit host exposure requires host, catalog and resolvePlugin together.
catalog: Application-authored IRemoteHostCatalog declaring the only plugin contracts available through explicitly exposed host control.
Omitted: no host-control catalog; required when expose contains host.
resolvePlugin: Synchronous local resolver invoked by the canonical host-control owner after catalog admission; definitions remain local and are installed through the original Host.
resolvePlugin.name: Plugin name admitted by the declared catalog.
resolvePlugin.config: Optional portable configuration from the remote host-use request.
Local plugin definition accepted by the Host; a thrown error rejects the host-use request.
Omitted: no local resolver; required when expose contains host.
task: Parent-only task callback receiving signal, heartbeat and the opaque child connect token; task settlement is unit exit and rejection retains its cause.
task.context: ICoroutineTaskContext from the original supervisor: native signal, heartbeat() and the opaque connect token to pass into the child plugin.
Void or PromiseLike<unknown>; settlement ends the task generation. Rejection records the original task failure and restart follows the selected supervisor policy.
Omitted only in child mode, which requires connect.
supervisor: Parent-only policy selecting existing coroutine restart, startup, stop, heartbeat and budget behavior.
Omitted: use supervision defaults and a one-unit coroutine budget.
Installation adds the canonical coroutine outlet. Parent plugins own tasks; child plugins only borrow the supplied generation connection.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates a parent task owner or child connection plugin; the two modes must be used together through the genuine task connect token.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import createCoroutinePlugin from @migaia/rpc-core/remote, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use createCoroutinePlugin when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when createCoroutinePlugin does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained function example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
options: Application name and provided methods plus exactly one parent task or child connect token.
Cold plugin for the coroutine Host outlet; parent disposal cooperatively stops its task, child disposal closes only its connection.
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.
No result is used; reporter errors are contained by the reporting boundary.
Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
authentication.encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
authentication.encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
authentication.encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.
Omitted: this stage is absent; signing/verification must still be configured and encryption/decryption must be supplied together.
authentication.decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
authentication.decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
authentication.decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Recovered replay-bound authentication envelope or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with the original cause.
authentication.sign: Outbound sync/async signing runs after optional encryption and returns the complete protected frame representation. Signing and verification are required even without encryption.
authentication.sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.
authentication.sign.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.
authentication.verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
authentication.verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
authentication.verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Authenticated inner value or its Promise, passed to decrypt when configured; reject or throw on invalid signatures. Local reporting retains the original verification failure, which may be sensitive; the peer receives a sanitized summary. Other returned values still undergo envelope/replay validation.
authentication.encodedType: Declared protected-output domain must match the next physical pipeline edge. Encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify are complete pairs, at least signing is required, and encryption additionally requires signing.
any: do not impose a declared protected-output value category.
Leave the declared output domain unconstrained; transforms may still change representation.
Declare that the protected output is text for the subsequent pipeline edge.
Declare that the protected output is a byte array for the subsequent pipeline edge.
connect: Child-only token supplied by the current parent task context; arbitrary objects and tokens from other ownership paths are rejected.
Omitted only in parent mode, which requires task.
name: Caller-selected nonempty registration name copied when constructing the cold plugin; use the same name when addressing the installed runtime outlet.
expose: Distinct nonempty paths explicitly exposing current Host feature methods, runtime connection routes or the reserved host control entry. Only this snapshotted whitelist becomes remotely callable.
Omitted: an empty whitelist; only provide methods are published.
host: The same actual PluginHost handle into which this plugin is installed, supplying use, unUse, plugin and revision for explicit host exposure.
Omitted: allowed unless expose contains host; explicit host exposure requires host, catalog and resolvePlugin together.
catalog: Application-authored IRemoteHostCatalog declaring the only plugin contracts available through explicitly exposed host control.
Omitted: no host-control catalog; required when expose contains host.
resolvePlugin: Synchronous local resolver invoked by the canonical host-control owner after catalog admission; definitions remain local and are installed through the original Host.
resolvePlugin.name: Plugin name admitted by the declared catalog.
resolvePlugin.config: Optional portable configuration from the remote host-use request.
Local plugin definition accepted by the Host; a thrown error rejects the host-use request.
Omitted: no local resolver; required when expose contains host.
task: Parent-only task callback receiving signal, heartbeat and the opaque child connect token; task settlement is unit exit and rejection retains its cause.
task.context: ICoroutineTaskContext from the original supervisor: native signal, heartbeat() and the opaque connect token to pass into the child plugin.
Void or PromiseLike<unknown>; settlement ends the task generation. Rejection records the original task failure and restart follows the selected supervisor policy.
Omitted only in child mode, which requires connect.
supervisor: Parent-only policy selecting existing coroutine restart, startup, stop, heartbeat and budget behavior.
Omitted: use supervision defaults and a one-unit coroutine budget.
Installation adds the canonical coroutine outlet. Parent plugins own tasks; child plugins only borrow the supplied generation connection.

sections.content: Creates a Peer facade on the original managed binding and generation holder, retaining restart and native execution ownership.

sections.content: Import createRemotePlugin from @migaia/rpc-core/remote, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use createRemotePlugin when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when createRemotePlugin does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
options: Application IRemotePluginOptions naming the exact registration and its real enablement Host.
Plugin definition to install through host.use; Host removal releases its generation resources.
contract: Normalized plugin contract or Host catalog returned by the remote normalizers.
binding: Actual platform binding supplying supervision, clock, channel acquisition and explicit execution ownership.
endpointFactory: Constructs the served endpoint from the complete channel and native cancellation signal; install its features in the same batch.
endpointFactory.channel: Channel returned by the binding openChannel operation.
endpointFactory.signal: Native signal issued for this generation preparation.
Promise of endpoint, optional one-way surface and stream runtime; failure rolls construction back.
report: Reports background or secondary cleanup failures synchronously; a thrown reporter failure follows the owner fallback.
report.error: Original background failure.
No result is consumed.
keyFactory: Synchronous application key factory used for automatically keyed idempotent requests.
A string logical key; a thrown factory failure rejects that request before sending.
Omitted: use defaultRpcId.
retryPort: Application retry dispatcher replacing the entire original retry dispatch operation.
Omitted: create the canonical retry port from binding events, scheduler and report.
callDeadlineCapMs: Optional positive finite platform ceiling on a logical call deadline, in milliseconds.
Omitted: no additional platform deadline ceiling.
callGuard: Optional synchronous pre-dispatch admission guard, after validation and before selecting a generation.
Omitted: no extra admission guard.
name: Application registration name that must match the contract plugin.
host: Caller-owned PluginHost enablement port controlling this exact registration.
Installation exposes only declared remote features on the PluginHost; departure suspends this contribution through its original owner.

export declare function createRuntimePeer<TRemote = never>(options: IRuntimePeerOptions, resources?: IRuntimePeerResources): Promise<[TRemote] extends [never] ? IRuntimePeer : IRuntimeTypedPeer<TRemote>>;

symbols.purpose: Creates one accepted direct Peer on exactly one supplied source; failure rolls acquired resources back before rejecting, including entropy failure before endpoint construction.
symbols.core:
options: Application IRuntimePeerOptions selecting one source and provided methods.
resources: Advanced original preparation resources supplied by the canonical adapter owner; ordinary applications omit this argument.
Promise of IRuntimePeer or typed IRuntimeTypedPeer after directory acceptance; caller owns close.
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.
No result is used; reporter errors are contained by the reporting boundary.
Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
authentication.encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
authentication.encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
authentication.encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.
Omitted: this stage is absent; signing/verification must still be configured and encryption/decryption must be supplied together.
authentication.decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
authentication.decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
authentication.decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Recovered replay-bound authentication envelope or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with the original cause.
authentication.sign: Outbound sync/async signing runs after optional encryption and returns the complete protected frame representation. Signing and verification are required even without encryption.
authentication.sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.
authentication.sign.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.
authentication.verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
authentication.verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
authentication.verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Authenticated inner value or its Promise, passed to decrypt when configured; reject or throw on invalid signatures. Local reporting retains the original verification failure, which may be sensitive; the peer receives a sanitized summary. Other returned values still undergo envelope/replay validation.
authentication.encodedType: Declared protected-output domain must match the next physical pipeline edge. Encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify are complete pairs, at least signing is required, and encryption additionally requires signing.
any: do not impose a declared protected-output value category.
Leave the declared output domain unconstrained; transforms may still change representation.
Declare that the protected output is text for the subsequent pipeline edge.
Declare that the protected output is a byte array for the subsequent pipeline edge.
spawn: Application source callback receiving the safe local identity and capability offer; choose exactly one source.
spawn.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Promise of a complete IRuntimePeerSourceResult with agreed pipeline and features; failure rejects construction and rolls back resources already acquired.
Omitted: this source kind is not selected.
connect: Application source callback opening a channel to an existing peer; choose exactly one source.
connect.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
listen: Application source callback accepting a negotiated peer channel; choose exactly one source.
listen.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
parameters: options: IRuntimePeerOptions
resources: IRuntimePeerResources (optional)

blocks.text: 首次 ready 已经包含在 `await createThreadPeer(...)` / `await createRuntimePeer(...)` 的完成里。`on('ready')` 从订阅时开始，只观察原 registration 后来真正接受的新代次。受监督的 Peer 从原 supervisor 获取 exit/restart/degraded；listener 的 ready 来自实际接受的 session。raw Peer 没有原生执行生命周期，不伪造 exit 或后续 ready。事件不是资源 disposer；释放仍用 `close` 或 `await using`。
下面的 Node Worker 自然退出，由真实 supervisor 发布 exit；父线程等待该事实，然后由 `await using` 释放 Peer：
`Symbol.asyncDispose` 与 `close` 是同一函数引用，重复或并发调用保留同一个原 Promise。取消订阅不会停止 Worker；Peer 开始关闭时注销其事件订阅。listener 没有原生执行控制，raw Peer 也不会把逻辑关闭包装成原生 exit。

provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.

providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.

symbols.core:
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.
`10000` milliseconds for each attempt.
restart: Automatic restart policy for classified exits; nested fields control mode, backoff and the failure window.
An empty policy uses the nested defaults below.
restart.mode: Chooses which actual exits schedule an automatic restart; manual restart remains available.
`on-failure`; normal completion stops.
restart.initialDelayMs: Finite nonnegative first restart delay in scheduler milliseconds.
`250` milliseconds before the first retry.
restart.factor: Finite multiplier of successive restart delays; must be at least one.
`2`; each failure doubles the delay until its cap.
restart.maxDelayMs: Finite nonnegative upper bound of exponential retry delay in milliseconds.
`30000` milliseconds caps backoff.
restart.maxRestarts: Nonnegative safe integer controlling failures admitted in one sliding restart window.
`5` failures before exhaustion.
restart.windowMs: Finite nonnegative scheduler window for counting recent failures.
`60000` milliseconds of failure history.
terminalPolicy: After exhaustion, keeps terminal admission closed or schedules an explicit cooldown.
Absent: remain terminal until explicit restart.
terminalPolicy.mode: Selects a terminal wait until explicit restart or a timed cooldown retry after exhaustion; only disposal permanently closes the supervisor.
terminalPolicy.afterMs: Finite nonnegative cooldown duration required only for the cooldown policy.
stop: Ordered application drain, graceful exit and forced reap phases for each retiring unit.
Absent: each phase uses its nested default.
stop.beforeTerminate: Asynchronous application drain receiving handle, native cancellation signal and remainingMs getter; resolve when drained. Failure is reported and termination proceeds.
Absent: skip application draining work.
stop.drainTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative maximum application drain time; a command graceMs overrides this phase only.
`5000` milliseconds for application drain.
stop.exitTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative wait for actual graceful exit before requesting force.
`5000` milliseconds before force.
stop.reapTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative recovery wait after force; a timed-out unit keeps its lease until actual exit.
`5000` milliseconds of forced recovery.
budget: Shared matching-kind budget returned by `createUnitBudget`; actual exit releases its occupied lease.
Omitted: create a one-unit coroutine budget rejecting overflow.
heartbeat: Optional heartbeat-age watchdog observing task progress rather than native health.
Absent: no heartbeat watchdog is installed.
heartbeat.timeoutMs: Finite positive maximum scheduler age since the last explicit or iterator heartbeat.
heartbeat.intervalMs: Positive scheduler interval between heartbeat-age observations.
The configured heartbeat.timeoutMs duration.
heartbeat.failureThreshold: Consecutive stale heartbeat observations required before invalidating the coroutine.

name: Connection name, e.g. the plugin `name`.
instanceId: Instance id of that generation, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
generation: Generation number, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
timestamp: Scheduler time of the observation, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
clock: Clock of `timestamp`; `scheduler`.
reason: `exit` only: why the unit exited.
code: `exit` only: exit code, or unavailable.
signal: `exit` only: terminating signal, or unavailable.
error: `exit` / `terminal`: `{ source, code }` of the failure.
count: `restart` only: how many restarts so far.
degraded: `degraded` only: features that are degraded.

guidance.heading: 2.5 作用域释放与真实生命周期事件

blocks.text: 首次 ready 已经包含在 `await createThreadPeer(...)` / `await createRuntimePeer(...)` 的完成里。`on('ready')` 从订阅时开始，只观察原 registration 后来真正接受的新代次。受监督的 Peer 从原 supervisor 获取 exit/restart/degraded；listener 的 ready 来自实际接受的 session。raw Peer 没有原生执行生命周期，不伪造 exit 或后续 ready。事件不是资源 disposer；释放仍用 `close` 或 `await using`。
下面的 Node Worker 自然退出，由真实 supervisor 发布 exit；父线程等待该事实，然后由 `await using` 释放 Peer：
`Symbol.asyncDispose` 与 `close` 是同一函数引用，重复或并发调用保留同一个原 Promise。取消订阅不会停止 Worker；Peer 开始关闭时注销其事件订阅。listener 没有原生执行控制，raw Peer 也不会把逻辑关闭包装成原生 exit。

symbols.name: IRuntimePeerOptions
symbols.signature: export type IRuntimePeerOptions = Pick<IRemoteProxyOptions<object, unknown>, 'keyFactory' | 'retryPort'> & Readonly<{ /** A custom runtime assembly receives only the operations held by this channel view. */ endpointFactory?(channel: IRemoteChannelResources, signal: INativeAbortSignal): Promise<IRemoteServeEndpoint>; self?: IRuntimePeerIdentity; provide?: IRuntimePeerProvide; spawn?: IRuntimePeerSource; connect?: IRuntimePeerSource; listen?: IRuntimePeerSource; providerLimits?: IRpcProviderLimits; /** Existing per-frame credentials enable signed native transfer without a custom endpoint. */ authentication?: IRpcAuthenticationConfig; /** Installs an endpoint-local synchronous observer without changing pipeline selection. */ probe?: IRpcProbe | readonly IRpcProbe[]; /** Only request/stream inherit this positive default in their original timeout scope. */ defaultTimeoutMs?: number; /** Explicit advanced schema, modes and idempotency retain their original contract owner. */ contract?: IRemoteContract; /** Omission reports background failures to console.error through the original owner. */ report?(error: unknown): void; }>;
symbols.purpose: Core peer configuration selecting exactly one application source and actual provided methods.
symbols.core:
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.
No result is used; reporter errors are contained by the reporting boundary.
Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
authentication.encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
authentication.encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
authentication.encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.
Omitted: this stage is absent; signing/verification must still be configured and encryption/decryption must be supplied together.
authentication.decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
authentication.decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
authentication.decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Recovered replay-bound authentication envelope or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with the original cause.
authentication.sign: Outbound sync/async signing runs after optional encryption and returns the complete protected frame representation. Signing and verification are required even without encryption.
authentication.sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.
authentication.sign.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.
authentication.verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
authentication.verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
authentication.verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Authenticated inner value or its Promise, passed to decrypt when configured; reject or throw on invalid signatures. Local reporting retains the original verification failure, which may be sensitive; the peer receives a sanitized summary. Other returned values still undergo envelope/replay validation.
authentication.encodedType: Declared protected-output domain must match the next physical pipeline edge. Encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify are complete pairs, at least signing is required, and encryption additionally requires signing.
any: do not impose a declared protected-output value category.
Leave the declared output domain unconstrained; transforms may still change representation.
Declare that the protected output is text for the subsequent pipeline edge.
Declare that the protected output is a byte array for the subsequent pipeline edge.
spawn: Application source callback receiving the safe local identity and capability offer; choose exactly one source.
spawn.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Promise of a complete IRuntimePeerSourceResult with agreed pipeline and features; failure rejects construction and rolls back resources already acquired.
Omitted: this source kind is not selected.
connect: Application source callback opening a channel to an existing peer; choose exactly one source.
connect.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
listen: Application source callback accepting a negotiated peer channel; choose exactly one source.
listen.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
name: Caller-selected nonempty registration name copied when constructing the cold plugin; use the same name when addressing the installed runtime outlet.
expose: Distinct nonempty paths explicitly exposing current Host feature methods, runtime connection routes or the reserved host control entry. Only this snapshotted whitelist becomes remotely callable.
Omitted: an empty whitelist; only provide methods are published.
host: The same actual PluginHost handle into which this plugin is installed, supplying use, unUse, plugin and revision for explicit host exposure.
Omitted: allowed unless expose contains host; explicit host exposure requires host, catalog and resolvePlugin together.
catalog: Application-authored IRemoteHostCatalog declaring the only plugin contracts available through explicitly exposed host control.
Omitted: no host-control catalog; required when expose contains host.
resolvePlugin: Synchronous local resolver invoked by the canonical host-control owner after catalog admission; definitions remain local and are installed through the original Host.
resolvePlugin.name: Plugin name admitted by the declared catalog.
resolvePlugin.config: Optional portable configuration from the remote host-use request.
Local plugin definition accepted by the Host; a thrown error rejects the host-use request.
Omitted: no local resolver; required when expose contains host.

symbols.purpose: A Runtime Peer typed by `TRemote`: method names, payloads and results are checked against the other side API. Also has `self`, `describe()`, `outcome()`, `on()` and `close()`.
symbols.core:
self: Frozen local peer name and instanceId minted or supplied during this connection construction; it is not a remote authentication principal.
outcome: Queries the original remote operation ledger for a prior idempotency key, without dispatching that operation again.
outcome.idempotencyKey: The caller-issued key supplied as options.idempotencyKey on an earlier request to this connection.
Promise of IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult; support and availability come from the accepted remote runtime contract.
describe: Queries the local accepted peer detail asynchronously. Without format returns IRuntimeDetail; json, yaml or toml returns the admitted text projection. It does not claim unavailable physical metrics.
describe.options: Optional query format from IRuntimeQueryOptions; omitted returns the object snapshot.
Promise of local detail or formatted text, following the selected query format.
on: Registers a future RuntimeEventName listener after construction; factory resolution already represents initial readiness. Listener return is ignored and failures are contained by the runtime reporter.
on.event: A RuntimeEventName value such as ready or exit; it selects future connection lifecycle notifications.
on.listener: Callback receives IRuntimeEvent from this connection; return is ignored and throws or rejected thenables are reported.
Idempotent removal function for this registration; closing the peer clears its publisher.
close: Ends this logical connection and releases its owned channel resources; platform factories also terminate a worker or child they spawned.
Shared completion Promise retaining the original close operation identity; no new calls are admitted once closing begins.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Scoped asynchronous cleanup is the exact original close operation, including its Promise identity.
The same completion Promise as close(), including platform-owned resource cleanup.
request: Calls a method the other side provides and waits for its result. Default deadline 30000 ms (`defaultTimeoutMs`); errors keep their native type and `(source, code)`.
request.method: Dotted path of a method in the other side `provide`, e.g. `math.double`.
request.args: `(payload?, options?)`: one payload and call options (`timeoutMs`, `signal`, `transfer`, `idempotencyKey`).
The method result, typed from `TRemote`.
notify: Sends a one-way call; no result comes back.
notify.method: Dotted method path provided by the other side.
notify.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
Resolves once the call was sent.
stream: Calls a method that returns an iterable and yields its items as they arrive.
stream.method: Dotted path of an iterator method provided by the other side.
stream.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
An async iterator of the yielded items.
group: Sends several calls as one batch and returns the outcome of each step in order.
group.steps: Steps `{ method, payload? }` in order.
group.options: Batch options such as `timeoutMs` and `signal`.
One outcome per step (success value or error).
symbols.advanced:
Call worker or child process functions as if they were local, with types.
Retry a non-idempotent call safely with `idempotencyKey` and `outcome(key)`.

blocks.text: 所有错误都是原生 `Error`（或子类），附带 `source` 与 `code`。按 `(source, code)` 分支，不要匹配 `message`。

items: `isRpcErrorInstance`、`isRpcRemoteError`、`isRpcTimeoutError` 按稳定字段判断，跨 Worker、iframe、模块副本都有效；不要依赖 `instanceof`。
`isRpcError` 只检查 `code` 是否为字符串，不能代替上面三个守卫。
错误类（`RpcError`、`RpcRemoteError`、`RpcTimeoutError` 等）只作为类型导出。唯一可构造的运行时类是 `RpcLifecycleError`，供持有自身释放状态的消费方（例如 Store Worker）报告生命周期失败。

blocks.text: 公开错误形状使用 `IRpcError`；平台与拓扑值域使用 `IRpcPlatformValue`、`IRpcTransportTopologyValue`。工厂组合类型从实际调用结果推导，认证 nonce 由认证 owner 内部生成。

blocks.text: 所有错误都是原生 `Error`（或子类），附带 `source` 与 `code`。按 `(source, code)` 分支，不要匹配 `message`。
